data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure step for step: Check my bus, Track my bus, the Service Number tab, typing the number, then selecting a suggestion or submitting. It also names the right parameter. It loses a point on feasibility because the "Select suggestion if shown" step is conditional and the "Find my bus" button it adds doesn't appear in the observed actions, so an automation might fail if that button isn't there.
